description: A correct fine-tune for a product manager resume against a JD that asks for Kubernetes, SQL and A/B testing the resume never shows. Each fault below breaks one rule the auditors exist to enforce.
resume:
Alex Rivera
[email] · [phone] · Cork
Product Manager | Smart home
SUMMARY
Product manager for connected home devices with an engineering background in embedded software.
EXPERIENCE
Northlight Devices · Product Manager · 2021 - 2024
Managed the roadmap for the smart thermostat line together with firmware and app teams
Worked with three ecosystem partners on certification and launch plans
Coordinated user research sessions and turned findings into backlog items
Brightwire Systems · Firmware Engineer · 2017 - 2021
Built device drivers and over-the-air update tooling for a home gateway
Wrote test plans for new sensor modules
SKILLS
Roadmapping, stakeholder management, Jira, embedded C, user research
jd:
Product Manager, Platform
Cloudwise
Dublin, Ireland (hybrid)

About the role
You will own the roadmap for our connected product line and work with engineering, design and partners to ship features customers value. You will talk to customers every week, decide priorities with data, and report results to leadership.

Responsibilities
- Define the product strategy and roadmap
- Work with firmware, cloud and app teams on delivery
- Run customer discovery and turn it into requirements
- Measure the impact of every release and report on it

Requirements
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes
- Strong SQL skills for analysis
- Experience designing and reading A/B testing results
- 3+ years in product management
